description: This PHP source file defines the QualificationsMenuConfigurator class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing menu configuration logic for the Qualifications menu in the Admin plugin, including a method to override the screen URL based on current module context.

classes.name: QualificationsMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the qualifications menu within the orangehrmAdminPlugin, overriding screen URLs based on the current module context.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen URL to replace 'save' with 'view' in the action URL, then returns null.
